scope: Default inline headers, footers and numbered footnotes in independent document tabs. This is not complete Google Docs fidelity.
changes: Native zero-based UTF-16 segment edits preserve body and sibling-tab state, support rich text/lists/header-footer tables and images, and reject unsupported/malformed segment actions atomically.
Insert > Page elements creates or opens native default header/footer/footnote; one shared editor preserves selection, formatting and the existing save queue.
Switching regions saves pending drafts; failures retain the draft and selected region.
Margins use native updateDocumentStyle; Cancel and Escape preserve complete native state.
Body-only Find returns to the body before highlighting/replacing. Table options and resize gestures carry segment identity and reject stale controls.
Header/footer controls wrap at 390px; footnote editor uses10pt text and grouped footnotes use one separator.
Segment saves preserve the Home-card body preview and still update its modified time.

Exports retain selected-tab header/footer and numbered footnote content across all ten supported formats. DOCX uses separate native section headers/footers and linked footnote parts, including references inside tables.
